messages:
Sofia (Onboarding): Hey everyone — kicking off BlueArc Labs onboarding. Primary goals: 1) private deployment in staging, 2) baseline eval for embeddings & reranking, 3) handoff to support before renewal. Target: staging by 2025-04-30, production pilot in May.

Emma (CS): thanks! quick Q — who’s the customer IT/security contact? also can we capture success criteria now so we don't drift? :memo:

Jordan (BlueArc): Aisha (IT) and Diego (Security) on our side. Confirming the timeline looks good from our PM. Success criteria from us: embedding latencies <50ms p50, search relevance uplift >=12% vs current, and end-to-end deploy in our VPC with audit logs enabled.

Raj (Solutions): noted. I'll own model selection + quantization recommendations. For embeddings workload I'd propose starting with rdx-embed-2 (fp16) then test int8 quant for cost. Possible risk: our quantization might change similarity scores — we'll need eval prompt set.

Liam (PM): high-level timeline (working days):
```
4/09 - Kickoff workshop (enablement + network pre-check)
4/14 - Configs & eval prompt set finalized
4/21 - Staging deploy + smoke tests
4/30 - Handoff readiness review (go/no-go)
```
I'll own the rollout plan and acceptance checklist.

Mei (Infra): heads-up on infra blockers: subnet peering + KMS/HSM approvals can take 5-10 biz days. Jordan, can you share network CIDR and KMS admin contact? Also need to confirm whether they require customer-managed key (CMK) in HSM.

Jordan (BlueArc): sharing contacts now: Aisha (aisha@bluearc.com) -> network, Diego (diego@bluearc.com) -> security/KMS. They prefer CMK in HSM.

Sofia (Onboarding): thanks Jordan — adding Aisha & Diego to invite. Action owners so far: Emma -> enablement docs & workshop, Raj -> model/quant configs + evals, Mei -> infra prep & network runbook, Liam -> rollout/checklist.

Emma (CS): for enablement, I'll prepare a short runbook + a recording template. Proposed success criteria (to capture):
- "Embeddings pipeline produces >=12% relevance uplift on X benchmark"
- "P50 embed latency < 50ms in staging"
- "End-to-end inference cost <= $Y per 1k queries (TBD)"
I'll put these in the shared doc and tag for review.

Raj (Solutions): I'll add a small AB test plan for quant vs fp16 to the repo. We should baseline on their current search dataset.

Mei (Infra): scheduling a network readiness call for 4/10 11am PT. calendar-bot: create meeting -> 4/10 11:00 PT (30m) with Aisha, Diego, Mei, Sofia, Emma.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: "BlueArc network prep" — 2025-04-10 11:00 PT. Invite sent to attendees.

Jordan (BlueArc): confirmed for 4/10. Also want to capture feedback during enablement — prefer short weekly pulse and a single feedback form after workshop.

Sofia (Onboarding): good call. I'll post a short feedback form link after the workshop and set weekly 15-min syncs leading up to 4/30.

Emma (CS): :thumbsup: I'll draft the feedback form + a short eval checklist (prompts + sample scoring).

Liam (PM): noted risks: KMS delays, score drift from quant, and any missing data access. Contingency: if CMK approval takes too long, plan for temporary hosted encrypted key with strict TTL.

Mei (Infra): agree on contingency. also we should validate log retention/exports for audit before handoff.

Sofia (Onboarding): perfect. Owners + timeline are set. I'll follow up with a one-pager (stakeholders, success criteria, timeline, risks, links) by EOD. Thanks everyone — let's aim to keep updates to this thread for async traceability.
